subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should `codexbar cookie refresh` be allowed to clear an existing usable cookie when the CLI cannot immediately re-import it, or should it fail without mutation unless refresh is possible?
rationale: Either implementation is mechanically feasible, but whether a user-facing authentication-recovery command may invalidate a working cache is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Require replacement before clearing
options.body: Keep the existing cached cookie unless the import-capable path obtains a replacement, preventing an attempted refresh from causing a later authentication failure.

options.title: Keep cache-clear fallback
options.body: Allow the fallback only if help and output clearly state that a later signed-app refresh must restore the session and maintainers accept that recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Require replacement before clearing
recommendation.body: Keep the existing cached cookie unless the import-capable path obtains a replacement, preventing an attempted refresh from causing a later authentication failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history ties the CLI refresh and access-gate design most directly to steipete.
